Title: Implement splitbrain_inspect_agent tool (live agent state during execution)
Description: Returns live state of a running agent: iteration count, token usage so far, tool calls made in each iteration, current role (Planner/Implementer/Reviewer), approaching-limit warnings. Parameters: agentId. The current agent system is a black box during execution. An agent on iteration 7/10 with 45k/50k tokens should surface that to callers. Required for the bounded, deterministic agent design goal of full observability.
